polls.description: Governments worldwide imposing new restrictions on AI including deepfake prosecutions, EU children's protections, and high-level summits on autonomous weapons and safety concerns.
polls.question: Are AI companies moving too fast to ensure safety?

cluster_stories.title: Kamala Harris asks Congress for a new AI regulator and a treaty with China
cluster_stories.summary: Kamala Harris posted a four-paragraph statement on X on Monday night setting out what she wants Washington to do about AI. She asked Congress to pass new laws and “establish a new federal entity to provide oversight and independent testing” for frontier models. She asked the president to pursue a treaty with countries including China […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: KAMALA HARRIS CALLS FOR NEW AI REGULATOR... CHINA TREATY

cluster_stories.title: US, China security experts propose nuclear-style safeguards for AI risks
cluster_stories.summary: Article URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-china-security-experts-propose-nuclear-style-safeguards-ai-risks-2026-09-17/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49746248 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA PROPOSE NUCLEAR-STYLE AI SAFEGUARDS

cluster_stories.title: King Charles Calls on Nvidia, OpenAI Chiefs to Control AI
cluster_stories.summary: Britain’s monarch plans to ask some of the most critical figures in artificial intelligence for reassurances the technologists can keep their inventions under control.
cluster_stories.headline: KING CHARLES SUMMONS NVIDIA, OPENAI CHIEFS: 'CONTROL YOUR AI'

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia CEO Puts Trump on Phone While Downplaying AI Risk
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a live phone call from Donald Trump during a panel discussion, allowing the US president to dismiss artificial intelligence dangers as a “hoax." Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP CALLS NVIDIA CEO LIVE: AI RISK A 'HOAX'

cluster_stories.title: At UN, Nations Wrestle With the Rise of Autonomous Weapons
cluster_stories.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said the world is “now dangerously close to crossing a moral red line.”
cluster_stories.headline: UN CHIEF: World 'Dangerously Close' to Autonomous Weapons Red Line

cluster_stories.title: EU to restrict social media and chatbots for children under 15
cluster_stories.summary: Ursula von der Leyen describes AI as ‘second tipping point of our time’ after climate change
cluster_stories.headline: EU BANS SOCIAL MEDIA FOR KIDS UNDER 13, RESTRICTS AI CHATBOTS

cluster_stories.title: EU Unveils Social Media Curbs for Kids and Ban on Users Under 13
cluster_stories.summary: The European Union is working to ban social media for kids under 13 and restrict the use of technology and artificial intelligence services for older children, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in her annual address Wednesday.
cluster_stories.headline: EU UNVEILS SOCIAL MEDIA BAN FOR UNDER-13s

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, GOOGLE IN SECRET SAFETY TALKS

cluster_stories.title: King Charles III Urges AI Leaders to Protect Humanity at Summit
cluster_stories.summary: Can technology leaders keep AI under control? King Charles asked industry heads including Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and Google DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis at his Scotland Summit, Shona Ghosh reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: KING CHARLES WARNS AI LEADERS: PROTECT HUMANITY

cluster_stories.title: The EU Wants to Break Up Kids and Their Chatbots
cluster_stories.summary: ChatGPT, Character.ai, and Snapchat’s My AI will all be in the crosshairs as the AI Kids Act aims to strip minor-facing chatbots of all the things that make people love them.
cluster_stories.headline: EU TARGETS KIDS' CHATBOTS: Character.AI, ChatGPT Face Crackdown

cluster_stories.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
cluster_stories.summary: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.
cluster_stories.headline: KING CHARLES HOSTS AI SUMMIT... Admits His Own Hesitations

cluster_stories.title: US Weighs Antitrust Guidance on AI Safety, Top DOJ Official Says
cluster_stories.summary: The Trump administration is considering whether to update interagency antitrust guidance on cybersecurity to address a new wave of threats posed by artificial intelligence, according to Associate US Attorney General Stanley Woodward.
cluster_stories.headline: US DOJ Weighs New AI Safety Antitrust Rules

cluster_stories.title: King Charles to tell AI leaders to keep the technology in the service of humanity
cluster_stories.summary: King Charles will host a meeting at Dumfries House, his Ayrshire estate and the home of the King’s Foundation, having invited executives from Nvidia, Google DeepMind, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The event is being run by the Ditchley Foundation, the King’s Trust, the King’s Foundation and the Sustainable Markets Initiative. Politico had reported last week that […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: KING CHARLES SUMMONS AI CHIEFS: Nvidia, OpenAI, DeepMind to Palace

polls.description: Global leaders and governments are implementing new safeguards, regulations, and international treaties to control AI risks ranging from autonomous weapons to children's chatbot access.
